title: Dad's new look
kaylee: Dad looks more like Dad: messy brown hair, blue eyes, a t-shirt and shorts, and a purple curl of a tail.
questions: Is the small smile right, or do you want his big open grin back?

pictures.title: Before and after
pictures.caption: Brown tousled hair and brows, blue eyes, pink nose on a cream muzzle, round ears, a twisted horn. The shirt stays yellow.

pictures.title: All the way round
pictures.caption: The curl of his tail swings out to one side, so it shows from the front too.

pictures.title: With the family
pictures.caption: Same height and build as before, so every scene still fits him.

pictures.title: At the barber
pictures.caption: Her strands take the place of his hair, and start out brown. Here: long and red.
